title: Pan-Seared Quesadilla with Mushrooms
description: A twist on the classic quesadilla, featuring sautéed mushrooms and a crispy crust.

ingredients.name: 2 quick flour tortillas
ingredients.notes: any type of flour tortilla works

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup shredded cheese
ingredients.notes: cheddar or Monterey Jack work well

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Place one of the tortillas in the skillet and sprinkle with cheese.
Add the mushroom mixture on half of the tortilla, then fold the tortilla in half.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for another 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also crispy.
Repeat with the remaining tortilla and filling.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot.
